name: wolfSSL/wolfssl
description: A lightweight, fast TLS/SSL library for embedded devices and IoT, supporting TLS 1.3 and DTLS 1.3. Up to 20x smaller than OpenSSL with FIPS certifications and post-quantum TLS support.
score_rationale: Strong embedded TLS library with 2.8k stars, actively maintained through March 2026, widely used in IoT and embedded security applications.
